title: A Postcard for the Orchard Anew
author: Ines Zhou
blurb: Marguerite Kavanagh, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
